questions.stem: An old woman, Nanda suffered a stroke for which she was given alteplase. She improved considerably. To prevent the recurrence of stroke, this patient is most likely to be treated indefinitely with :
questions.solutionHtml:
Aspirin

Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 677

questions.stem: Mohan, a 67- year old male comes to the physician’s office complaining of severe pain in the right foot with paleness of the right toe.The patient had a history of receiving unfractionated heparin 7 days back. The hemogram of the patient is as shown:Hb 13.2 g/dlWBC 10000/mm3Platelet 50000/mm3Which of the following should be used to treat this condition?
questions.solutionHtml:
Argatroban

Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 665

questions.stem: An old lady came with a complaint of pain in the left calf region. A diagnosis of deep vein thrombosis( DVT) was made and she was put on warfarin therapy. After 3 months, she was brought to the hospital with a complaint of nose bleed which automatically stopped in a few minutes. Her lab reports show an INR of 7. To avoid hemorrhage, what to do next in addition to discontinuation of the drug?
questions.solutionHtml:
Vitamin K1

Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 616

questions.stem: Which drug is metabolized primarily by CYP 2C19?
questions.solutionHtml:
Clopidogrel

Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 678

questions.stem: What is the mechanism of action of streptokinase?

options.label: A
options.text: It activates the conversion of fibrin to fibrin-split products

options.label: B
options.text: It activates the conversion of plasminogen to plasmin

options.label: C
options.text: It inhibits the conversion of prothrombin to thrombin

options.label: D
options.text: It inhibits the conversion of fibrinogen to fibrin

questions.answerText: It activates the conversion of plasminogen to plasmin
questions.solutionHtml:
It activates the conversion of plasminogen to plasmin

Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 673
